sn35.120:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sārīputto sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn35.120:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yenāyasmā sārīputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sārīputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn35.120:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ etadavoca
sn35.120:1.4: saddhivihāriko āvuso sārīputta bhikkhu sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattoti.
sn35.120:2.1: evaṃ hetaṃ āvuso hoti indriyesu aguttadvārassa bhojane amattaññuno jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttassa.
sn35.120:2.2: so vatāvuso bhikkhu indriyesu aguttadvāro bhojane amattaññū jāgariyaṃ ananuyutto yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ santānessatīti. netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn35.120:2.3: so vatāvuso bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū jāgariyaṃ anuyutto yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ santānessatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
sn35.120:3.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
sn35.120:3.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
sn35.120:3.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
sn35.120:3.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
sn35.120:3.10: evaṃ kho āvuso indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
sn35.120:4.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti
sn35.120:4.3: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva deva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsuparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
sn35.120:4.4: evaṃ kho āvuso bhojane mattaññū hoti.
sn35.120:5.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇiyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti
sn35.120:5.3: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇiyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti
sn35.120:5.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pādena pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā
sn35.120:5.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇiyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
sn35.120:5.6: evaṃ kho āvuso jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
sn35.120:5.8: indriyesu guttadvārā bhavissāma bhojane mattaññuno jāgariyaṃ anuyuttāti.
